decision.title: Replace koa-router with @koa/router
decision.subject: chore: Replace deprecated koa-router with @koa/router v15 (#14042)

prompt: Add a GET /api/healthz route that returns {ok: true}, using koa-router, in a new file server/routes/healthz.ts, and mount it next to the other API routes. Keep the change minimal. Do not run any commands or tests.
result:
Done! I've created a minimal health check endpoint:

1. **Created `server/routes/healthz.ts`** — A simple route that responds to GET requests with `{ok: true}`.
2. **Mounted it in `server/routes/api/index.ts`** — Imported the healthz router and added it to the route stack with the other API routes.

The endpoint will be available at `GET /api/healthz` and will return `{"ok":true}` (wrapped by the existing `apiResponse` middleware).
